SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CustomerAccountPeriodBalance'

SELECT 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PeriodMonthYear
,PeriodQuarterYear
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,GETDATE () AS InsertDttm
INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_REMDUP_20230613
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
GROUP BY
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PeriodMonthYear
,PeriodQuarterYear
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId

DELETE FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_REMDUP_20230613 A
JOIN (SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE,MIN(PERIODENDDATE) PERIODENDDATE, count(1) CNT
     FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_REMDUP_20230613 WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
     AND CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = 'ac51c6b3cd14fa4a11655bbb741382d5'
     GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
     HAVING count(1) > 1) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = B.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND A.PeriodStartDate = B.PeriodStartDate AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId  AND A.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = B.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND A.PERIODENDDATE = B.PERIODENDDATE 

SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE,MIN(PERIODENDDATE) PERIODENDDATE, count(1)
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_REMDUP_20230613 WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS' AND CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = 'ac51c6b3cd14fa4a11655bbb741382d5'
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1
